meta.title: Hamilton Textiles — Fine Fabrics by the Metre · Riffa, Bahrain
meta.description: Abaya, thobe, silk, cotton and linen fabrics cut to your length. Shop online from Hamilton Textiles in Riffa, Bahrain — delivered across Bahrain and worldwide.

announcement: Free delivery across Bahrain on orders over BD 15 · Cut to order, by the metre

hero.eyebrow: Riffa, Bahrain · Fabrics by the metre
hero.title: Fabric worth taking your time over.
hero.body: Hand-picked abaya crepes, thobe cottons, silks and linens — cut to the length you need and delivered to your door.

promise.title: The Hamilton promise
promise.cutBody: Order from half a metre up — every piece is measured and cut by hand in our Riffa shop.
promise.qualityBody: Every roll is inspected before it reaches our shelves. Zoom in on any fabric to see the weave.
promise.deliveryBody: Next-day delivery across Bahrain, and tracked shipping worldwide.
promise.secureBody: Pay with BenefitPay or card. Your payment details never touch our servers.

calculator.title: Not sure how much to buy?
calculator.body: Tell us what you're making and your height — we'll suggest the right length, with a little extra for seams.
calculator.note: Based on a 150 cm wide fabric. Wider fabrics need less.

visit.title: Come and feel the fabric
visit.body: Our shop in Hunainiya, Riffa is open every day. Bring a sample and we'll help you match it.
visit.address: Hunainiya, Riffa, Kingdom of Bahrain · P.O. Box 901
visit.hours: Open daily · hours to be confirmed

footer.tagline: Fine fabrics by the metre, from Riffa to the world.

currency.note: Prices in {currency} are approximate. You'll be charged in Bahraini Dinar (BHD).

cart.emptyBody: Browse our fabrics and add the lengths you need.

cart.freeDeliveryRemaining: Add <amount></amount> more for free delivery in Bahrain

shop.title: All fabrics

collections.title: Our collections
collections.intro: From fluid abaya crepes to crisp thobe cloth — find the right fabric for what you're making.

paid.title: Thank you!
paid.body: Your payment went through and your order is confirmed. We'll start cutting your fabric and send you updates.

failed.title: Payment not completed
failed.body: No money was taken. You can try again, or message us on WhatsApp and we'll help.
